title: LIVE UV INDEX
source_name: NOAA/NCEP CPC Global UV Index, operational GRIB2 (12 UTC GFS run, hourly steps to 120 h)
variable: uvi (UV index field in GRIB2 carries erythemally weighted flux in W/m^2; UV Index = flux x 40, applied exactly once)
what: Erythemal (sunburning) UV Index at the lake surface from the newest 12 UTC NCEP run, forecast hour nearest the current time. A forecast field, not a satellite observation: the displayed hour advances as time passes.
why_extreme: Extreme UV (11+) compresses into violet/deep-purple; ordinary low/moderate values own most of the color resolution.
